_description: Accepted h2 heading synonyms for SKILL.md files. Each key is the canonical heading (first entry in its array). A skill passes the section check if any synonym in its group appears as an h2 (## ...) line. Reason for this design: prior incidents where semantically equivalent but textually distinct headings (e.g. 'Key Decisions to Document' vs 'Decision Points') broke the linter. Keep additions conservative and documented.
